title: No Foreign Transaction Fee Credit Card
body:
Hello there,
Travelling soon, so was looking for a No Foreign Transaction Fee Card which can give some kind of bonus points once the minimum spend is met. The goal is to get the card travel and meet the minimum spend and then around late november close the card.
Don't want to get Wise as its not credit or gives any bonus points and bankwest requires to keep the card open for more than 12 months.
Any suggestions from somebody who is looking for something similar ?
All these changes coming after 01-Oct is getting confusing.
Cheers
